use default
use System.Math.log10

let leading_counts = (1::10) |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()

let previous mut = 0n
let current mut = 1n

for _ in 1::1000 do
    let first = current.to_string()[0]
    let digit = cast int(first) - cast int('0')
    leading_counts[digit] = leading_counts[digit] + 1

    let next = previous + current
    previous = current
    current = next
od

write_line("digit  actual   expected")

for digit in 1::9 do
    let actual = 100.0D * cast double(leading_counts[digit]) / 1000.0D
    let expected = 100.0D * log10(1.0D + 1.0D / cast double(digit))
    write_line("{digit}    {actual,6:F2}%  {expected,6:F2}%")
od
